Same data – other export?

From the same corrected TEI file, two XSLT selections deliver 20 or 24 words separated by empty space. The second selection includes solutions. This is a technical demonstration finding, not historical language statistics.

Therefore, extraction rule, selection and tooling are part of the research basis.

Vollständiges Analysemanifest: analysemanifest.json; eigenes Materialblatt Analyse.

For this demonstration DOI and Git-Commit are expressly empty. It is not a finished research quote and no real data publication.

Commit

Exact technical revision. Can be an untested interim version.

Example and Tip

Example: A commit identifies the change to a book file even if it is not yet released.

Tip: Commit messages explain the reason and scope; call the scientific data a release.

→
Tag and project release

Designated version with composition and modification instructions audited according to project rules.

Example and Tip

Example: v1.1 names a tested version and supplements the list of newly added collections.

Tip: Protect published tags and do not move them tacitly to another version.

→
archived version

Received data package with metadata and version identifier. For research call the specific version used.

Example and Tip

Example: A version reference leads to the received data package with which the investigation was carried out.

Tip: For the citation call the actual version used.
